claim_text: A new BRICS alliance against the dollar, the euro and SWIFT with a digital platform, and America losing the dollar standard in the days ahead, which he says is in the way of the beast system and is happening as he speaks.
quote: we will see the falling of the dollar standard
falsify_match: The dollar losing reserve status.
falsify_miss: It holds roughly sixty percent of allocated reserves. He says he prays it is not right now, which removes any window.

claim_text: The president addressing the nation over a plague, looking thinner and weeping in a Tim Tebow stance, with the virus this time affecting dogs, cows and birds and spreading through everything with nothing able to stop it.
quote: I saw that it affected dogs. It affected cows
falsify_match: A pathogen crossing between humans, cattle, dogs and birds at once.
falsify_miss: No such pathogen. H5N1 already moves between birds and cattle and occasionally to other mammals, which is the nearest existing case.

claim_text: He recalls the darkness over America lifting above the tree line as the president prayed in the Oval Office, and says he was told people will be thankful to have him because he will become a praying president, even more radically born again.
quote: he will become a praying president even more radically born again
falsify_match: A public conversion and open prayer practice by the president.
falsify_miss: No change in his public religious practice. He pre-empts the objection about swearing, which shows he expects the standard to be questioned.

claim_text: A radical conversion of Trump and Melania in the days ahead, and in conversation with another minister he places the rapture at the end of the current three and a half year window, at the start of the next shmita cycle in 2028 going into 2029.
quote: The next Schmita cycle starts in 2028 going into 2029
falsify_match: The rapture occurring in that window.
falsify_miss: 2029 passes. He frames it as what he is believing for rather than what he was told, and attributes the five year estimate to the other minister.

claim_text: The greatest wealth transfer ever imagined coming through crypto bills and a foundation of gold and silver, needed because preaching the gospel to every nation will cost billions if not trillions, with Bitcoin already at a hundred and twenty thousand.
quote: this will be the greatest wealth transfer we've ever could have
falsify_match: Funds of that order reaching evangelistic work.
falsify_miss: No such transfer. The Bitcoin figure he cites was the market price that week, not a forecast.

claim_text: He recounts telling a widow what to do with her insurance money, her not feeling peace about it, and says that had she acted it would have turned over fourteen million dollars in seven months, while what she chose instead fell from about seventy to eighteen.
quote: it would have turned over $14 million within the last seven months
falsify_match: An asset he named privately rising enough to produce that return in that period.
falsify_miss: No such asset, or the figures do not work. He names neither instrument, so only the shape of the story is on record. He also says he told her he missed it when she declined, then here says he did not.

claim_text: Thanks to viewers for supporting his appearance on the Kim Clement show, and a hope that everyone is hearing God so the work gets done together.
quote: thank you for coming over and supporting me on uh the Kim Clement show
falsify_match: Not applicable.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though it records his association with the Clement ministry.

claim_text: Teaching against hoarding a rainy day fund rather than sowing it, with the promise that there is more where that came from and an instruction to be a river rather than a dam.
quote: Don't be a damn, be a river
falsify_match: Not applicable; a giving appeal.
falsify_miss: Not applicable.

claim_text: He cites another pastor's item about a massive asteroid being discussed as Nibiru or Planet X and says it is all happening as given, with birthing pains now arriving back to back rather than every six months.
quote: this is what is being said about this asteroid coming
falsify_match: An object arriving on the terms described.
falsify_miss: No such object. He is repeating another channel's item rather than giving a vision here.

claim_text: Prayer after the Texas floods that listeners hear warnings in time and never be in the wrong place at the wrong time, and for the grieving families, with the observation that many will go home early if they are not listening.
quote: For many people will go home early if you're not listening
falsify_match: Not applicable; a petition after a disaster.
falsify_miss: Not applicable, though placing survival on whether people listened is a hard framing given the children who died.

claim_text: Revival spreading outside the four walls of the church into the streets, with gang members named and a healing and glory explosion on a street in St Louis.
quote: Crips, the Bloods. I want them. I want them born again
falsify_match: Street conversions at scale among named gangs.
falsify_miss: No such movement. The St Louis healing is described as already seen rather than foretold.

claim_text: He is shown the water and asks what is underneath the water in the Pacific Ocean, with Japan highlighted all over.
quote: What's underneath the water in the Pacific Ocean?
falsify_match: A major submarine event off Japan.
falsify_miss: No such event. The question is left unanswered in the session.

claim_text: A great shaking of the finances in China and a desperation coming on them, with the military doing things, Xi named, and a changing of who is in charge.
quote: I saw a great shaking of the finances in China
falsify_match: A Chinese financial crisis and a leadership change.
falsify_miss: Neither. Chinese property sector distress was already several years old when this was given.

claim_text: Monks seen surrendering with tears running down their faces, and a shaking in China that starts small and spreads out like a ripple, centred on the finances and on who is in charge.
quote: I see the monks. There's a great surrender
falsify_match: Buddhist monastic conversions in China at a visible scale.
falsify_miss: No such movement. Monks are the specific and unusual detail; the finance ripple is not.

claim_text: Key faces in China and the question of the right man for the job, with saving face, humiliation and honour at stake, and buildings shaken to dust as old systems, old structures and tradition are shaken.
quote: Tradition tradition is being shaken
falsify_match: A visible break with tradition in Chinese governance.
falsify_miss: No break. He says himself the words are nothing like what he is seeing, which limits what can be scored.

claim_text: The shift extended beyond China to Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, the Philippines and North Korea, with Vietnam and Thailand named and an instruction not to forget Vietnam.
quote: Don't forget Vietnam. Don't forget I see Vietnam
falsify_match: Religious movements across east and southeast Asia.
falsify_miss: No measurable change. Naming seven countries at once makes partial credit easy.

claim_text: Russia highlighted with a great harvest of souls coming into it despite the war, and Putin highlighted alongside.
quote: a great harvest of souls is coming into Russia
falsify_match: A measurable religious movement in Russia.
falsify_miss: No such movement. Russian Protestant activity is legally constrained, which makes it hard to observe either way.

claim_text: Men in blue jeans, blue jackets and white t-shirts bowing and worshipping and running towards a church in Russia, with revival in the streets there, which he says he rarely sees Russia for anything but war.
quote: I saw revival. I saw it happening in uh the streets in Russia
falsify_match: Street revival meetings in Russia.
falsify_miss: None. Public evangelism outside registered buildings is restricted under Russian law, which is the obstacle.

claim_text: A great shaking coming to Xi and the Chinese government, with the ring of fire activity described as a type and shadow of what is happening in the spirit, and revival about to break out across Asia including Japan and Taiwan.
quote: the ring of fire was a type and shadow
falsify_match: Political upheaval in Beijing alongside major Pacific seismicity.
falsify_miss: Neither. The type and shadow framing means ordinary seismicity can be read as the sign.

claim_text: A major earthquake and events out in the ocean followed by revival in Portland, Oregon, Seattle and British Columbia, with the shaking given as the means of the awakening.
quote: a revival will happen in Oregon, Seattle, British Columbia
falsify_match: A Cascadia earthquake followed by religious growth in the northwest.
falsify_miss: Neither. The Pacific northwest is the least religious region of the country, which is why he names it.

claim_text: California added to the northwest revival, with the statement that he is going after the darkest of the dark and the most unruly places.
quote: I'm going after the darkest of the dark
falsify_match: Religious growth concentrated in the least religious states.
falsify_miss: Growth stays where it already is. This is the same rule as the greater-the-blue material, stated differently.

claim_text: A race between China and another country he says he is not permitted to name, to perfect a new superhuman species of genetically altered bodies with the flaws taken out, with babies seen alive in cylinder tubes of bubbling amniotic fluid under a warming light, created without a mother.
quote: a species of human being of genetically altered bodies
falsify_match: An ectogenesis programme producing a live human birth outside a body.
falsify_miss: No such birth. He notes viewers telling him this has been reported for five or six years and says he takes no interest in that material.

claim_text: CERN copies being built around the world, a massive one in China and one in America, opening a thin black portal three or four feet across like a Stargate that is alive and can be reached through, from which they are getting information.
quote: it looked like some kind of demonic portal that they had created
falsify_match: A second and third large hadron collider built in China and America.
falsify_miss: China's proposed circular collider remains unfunded and no American equivalent is under construction. The portal half is not a physical claim that could be tested.

claim_text: Underground cities and bunkers in China for the elite on multiple levels, some of which are called the ark, with Zuckerberg named as having one, built because they know what is coming and will not tell the public.
quote: Some of these places were called the ark
falsify_match: Disclosure of a network of elite shelters called arks.
falsify_miss: No disclosure. The Zuckerberg shelter was already public and widely reported before this.

claim_text: An attempt to disarm America in the days ahead with mass shootings used to justify it, because firearms are in the way of the beast system, alongside Texas trying to secede with Oklahoma divided and wanting to join, and a warning to pray against a Democratic governor of Oklahoma in 2026.
quote: They will try to disarm America in the days ahead
falsify_match: Federal firearms confiscation legislation.
falsify_miss: No such legislation. The Oklahoma governor race in 2026 is dated and checkable; the state has not elected a Democratic governor since 2006.

claim_text: He says he warned six days earlier that what was happening in China with weather warfare would happen in America, with rain pouring down and massive flooding in minutes, and points to the twelve to sixteen inches in four hours that had just fallen.
quote: It's going to pour down rain in an area and there will be massive flooding
falsify_match: The recording six days earlier containing the specific warning.
falsify_miss: The earlier recording names China rather than a specific American place or date. The Texas Hill Country flood on 4 July 2025 killed more than a hundred people, and he is claiming it here.

claim_text: Snowstorms in the coming winter with snow as tall as houses falling in a matter of hours, so that people in certain cities have to dig themselves out, which he says he saw and which would look biblical.
quote: Snowstorms like as tall as their houses in a matter of just hours
falsify_match: Snowfall of six to eight feet in hours burying houses in an American city.
falsify_miss: No such storm. The American record for a single day is about six feet, at Silver Lake Colorado in 1921, so this would require matching the record over a wide area.

claim_text: Canada in a great financial deficit and depression with Carney telling everyone it is fine, making trade deals with Europe and Asia to save the economy, with sectors differing and Alberta worse than Toronto.
quote: Mark is his name was trying to um tell everybody everything was okay
falsify_match: A Canadian downturn with Alberta hit hardest and new trade agreements with Europe and Asia.
falsify_miss: Canada avoids recession or Ontario fares worse than Alberta. Naming which province suffers most is the checkable part.

claim_text: Alliances made through war between Macron, the German chancellor, the King of England and the pope, devising how to fund Zelensky without America while Trump turns his back on them with a snarl because they will not de-escalate.
quote: I saw the pope involved in this
falsify_match: A European funding arrangement for Ukraine excluding America, with papal involvement.
falsify_miss: Europe did increase its own funding through 2025, which is the ordinary course; the papal role is the part that would have to appear.

claim_text: The Berlin Wall recalled with half of Trump's face and half of Reagan's and the words about bringing down that wall, then cold war and the darkness of Cuba, with Cuba highlighted completely dark again and much darkness there.
quote: Pay attention to Cuba. There's much darkness here
falsify_match: A Cuban crisis or blackout of national scale.
falsify_miss: Cuba's grid failures are chronic and predate the warning, which makes darkness there the expected state rather than a sign.

claim_text: Japan split into two pieces by a crack he estimates at ten miles across or more with magma and lava coming up through it, and he allows that if it turns out to be two miles he has missed it.
quote: I could see Japan was in two pieces
falsify_match: A rift across the Japanese archipelago with magma.
falsify_miss: No such rift. A ten mile wide crack is not a thing continental crust does; he pre-emptively lowers the number to two miles, which is still an order of magnitude beyond any recorded surface rupture.

claim_text: The same splitting seen for America if Jerusalem is divided, with the land no longer one solid mass and bridges needing to be built, and a buoy off Japan rising a hundred feet on the swell as the sign of activity below the surface before a tsunami.
quote: It was no longer one solid piece of land mass
falsify_match: A continental rift across America following a division of Jerusalem.
falsify_miss: No such rift. The buoy detail is checkable: DART buoys register tsunami as centimetres of sea surface change, not a hundred feet of movement.

claim_text: Japanese skyscrapers swaying and moving around after the buoy, with one in particular white with a lot of glass moving back and forth.
quote: I saw the buildings swing, buildings swing, skyscrapers swing
falsify_match: A major Japanese earthquake filmed from a swaying tower.
falsify_miss: Japanese towers are designed to sway and are filmed doing so in every moderate quake, which makes this the expected picture rather than an unusual one.

claim_text: The Israel baby described with crooked buck teeth already in and a curl on its head, not pretty looking, against the America baby which looked like a chubby Gerber baby with a blue USA banner.
quote: that baby wasn't very cute looking
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable. The teeth are the detail he treats as meaning the Israeli birth is further along.

claim_text: He asks what the Fourth of July birthing meant since the day had passed, and is told it was the signing of the big beautiful bill, a four and a half trillion dollar budget bill, as the birthing of a new industrial revolution and a new age with crypto.
quote: What was signed on Fourth of July? The big beautiful bill
falsify_match: Not a prediction: the bill was signed on 4 July 2025, two days before this.
falsify_miss: Not applicable. This is the clearest instance in the corpus of an unexplained image being given its meaning after the fact from the news.

claim_text: People too busy putting children through college to look up, venting on social media as keyboard warriors and then going back into their rut without acting, not realising the seriousness of the hour, and he is told America and the nations will be shaken and there will be a major revival.
quote: they don't realize the seriousness of the hour
falsify_match: Not checkable as an event.
falsify_miss: Not checkable; inattention is the thing described.

claim_text: Zelensky moved like a marionette with Macron holding the main strings and Germany one small one, while Putin says he wants all of it and is buying time to outlast the American president, laughing at him and calling him a fool.
quote: I just got to buy time until Trump's out of office
falsify_match: Russia resuming a full offensive after January 2029.
falsify_miss: No such resumption. Outlasting the term places the test beyond 2029, which he states as the plan.

claim_text: Kim Jong-un and China seen as superpowers without four year elections that can simply outlast, wanting Poland as well as Ukraine, with Canada and others creating war to stimulate money because the euro was in trouble.
quote: we want that and we want Poland, too
falsify_match: Russian action against Poland.
falsify_miss: No action. The advantage-of-no-elections framing is an argument rather than a vision.

claim_text: The Lord upset about innocent blood in Ukraine because the puppet masters escalating it would not send their own sons, with young men dying by the tens of thousands and thirty thousand North Koreans going over there to die, and it is all for material gain, followed by candle-like lights in the Vatican windows.
quote: the 30,000 Korean North Koreans that are going over there
falsify_match: Thirty thousand North Korean troops deployed and killed in Ukraine.
falsify_miss: Deployment estimates through 2025 ran to about eleven to fifteen thousand with several thousand casualties, so the figure is roughly double the reported scale.

claim_text: DNA manipulation on animals bringing prehistoric species back, with a woolly mammoth returning soon as a clone or hybrid in a zoo as an attraction, a hairy looking elephant, and dinosaur-like animals attempted on the Jurassic Park pattern, out of China.
quote: I see a woolly mammoth coming back soon
falsify_match: A living mammoth hybrid displayed publicly.
falsify_miss: No such animal. Colossal Biosciences had publicly targeted 2028 for a mammoth calf and produced a modified mouse in March 2025, so the programme was in the news; the Chinese attribution is his own.

claim_text: Splicing genetics with long-lived animals in labs he says are not only in China, with a second location he is in and can see but is not permitted to name, under white rather than yellow lights, described as a race between the two.
quote: I cannot say the other the other place I see right now
falsify_match: Disclosure of longevity gene splicing programmes in two competing states.
falsify_miss: No disclosure. The withheld second country removes the checkable half, which is the recurring pattern.

claim_text: More than one CERN, with another hydrogen collider bigger than the European one being built in China, trying to open the door and find new dimensions, and he says there is going to be an accident.
quote: This is this is There's going to be an accident
falsify_match: An incident at a particle accelerator.
falsify_miss: No incident, or no larger collider built. China's proposed CEPC remains unapproved and unfunded, so the premise has to arrive first.

claim_text: Hospitals and medicine seen inside what he hears called a space race, an industrial revolution over who becomes the world leader in AI, driven by greed, splicing humans and animals.
quote: I hear the word space race
falsify_match: A single country establishing clear AI dominance.
falsify_miss: Capability stays distributed. The AI race framing was the dominant public narrative when this was given.

claim_text: America first in the new industrial revolution with China wanting to be next and Europe also in it, after which he says he cannot go any further and that the Lord wants to go a different direction.
quote: China wants to be the next one
falsify_match: China overtaking America in AI capability.
falsify_miss: America retains the lead. He cuts himself off, which removes whatever was going to follow.

claim_text: Underground cities again with one in China which he is told is an ark like Noah's, built because they see what is coming, and kept from the public at every level around the world because disclosure would cause mass chaos.
quote: They're arcs. The Lord has said that's an ark
falsify_match: Disclosure of state-built shelters described as arks.
falsify_miss: No disclosure. The claim that it is being concealed means the absence of evidence is treated as part of the claim.
